book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Mak wana Leleli

content: Yeisu wana Ulutuk Yelusalema I Ola Kin
Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago Yelusalema hi nopakelakelaubwa hi vin Betepage ge Bedani Oya Olibe awanina elal, inoke wana tohago eluwa i patunal nihi houwa.

I baek elal i ba, “Nuku nok nuku na awan toto maninilaa, ge sauga nuku ulutuk, donki natuna etega iyahe tei nuku kite hi am hikan, nige sauga etega gamagal etega i heheya pwatanaa. Nuku leke inoke nuku pwatanim te.
Ebo gamagal etega ni nelimiu ni ba, ‘Hauna kaiwena donki natuna ku leleke ei?’ nuku baek elana nuku ba, ‘Babala nuwana, yaa nige sauga ni yayapu inoke naha pasikalim al.’”
Yaka tohago hi nok hi na panuwaa, ge donki natuna hi pwawa hi am hikana limi etega ana nog bebenaa, i talmilila kamwasaa. Sauga hi lekaleka,
gamagalau bolo hi taltalmilila o hi nel elal hi ba, “Hauna kaiwena ge donki natuna ku leleke ei?”
Analiya hi lahe i ola hauna Yeisu i baunan eliyalil, inoke gamagalau hi talam ge tohago donki hi ahe hi egon.
Sauga hi pwatanik Yeisu elana, ali kaliko hi yao eputetenaa, inoke Yeisu i yawaha i misiyo.
Gamagalau hi gewi ali kaliko hi yao kamwasaa, yaka enuna al hi na kamwasa bebenaa, vegavega ginebi lamwana hi govel ge hi yao kamwasaa.
Inoke bolo hi nohouwa Yeisu awonaa ge bolo hi nawaa enaa hi yoga hi ba,

content.text: iya i nem Babala alana elana!”
“Yehoba ni ba muloluan, iya i nem wala Kin,
tubula Deibid wana abalogugui i pwatanim!”

content: Yeisu i na i vin Yelusalema, inoke i na i tuk Limi Bwabwalena elana. Matana i lipwapwati bugul gegewena i kitel, yaa iyaka i kokoyavi, inoke alonau wana tohago elulutega eluwa Yelusalema hi eguluwai hi na Bedani.
Poga nige Enona
Hi kenu lan i gan, yaka Bedani hi eguluwai hi nanawa Yelusalema kaiwena, inoke Yeisu i galebu.
Poga

etega i kitek laha, lamwana iyaka i siun ge i noyan, inoke i nok i na ni kite tab enona i gan. Sauga i nok i na gegelinaa, i kite nige enona i gagan, lamwana ya, kaiwena nigeya ga poga wali sauga enon i oola.
Yaka i baek ebwakil elana i ba, “Nige al gamagal etega enom ni kikibwa ge ni aan.” Inoke wana tohago baaba o hi hago.
Yeisu I Na I Ulutuk Limi Bwabwalena elana

Sauga Yeisu i vin Yelusalema, i na i ulutuk Limi Bwabwalena elana, inoke bolo hi lolopalipali ge bolo hi lolopwapwamola i takel. Mani ana tololopatal wali teibol ge bolo bunibuni hi palipali wali abamisiyo i yoho pwapwati,
ge gamagalau i lopwalil bahi wali bugubugul nihi kakaval solaa Limi Bwabwalena ana gana gamwanaa.

Inoke i panpankiti gamagalau elal i ba, “Buki Bwabwalena elana Yehoba wana baaba hi lelelian i ba, ‘No limi alana nuku tun tapwalolo limena gamagalau gegewel kaiweliya,’ yaa komiu ku ginol i ola tokaoma wali gol.”

Topowon bwabwatal ge Logugui ana topankite wasa ya hi hago, inoke kamwasa hi loya ga nihi ola ge Yeisu nihi lopaaliga, kaiwena boda nuwaliya i noek wana panpankiti elana inoke topowon bwabwatal Yeisu hi lovakunan.
Sauga bulin i gan, inoke Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago Yelusalema hi eguluwai.
Poga I Aliga ge Lamwana I Yakiwa
Lan i gan mweluluga, Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago hi nanawa kamwasaa Yelusalema kaiwena, inoke poga hi kite iyaka i aliga, aliga i telipunaa lamwanaa i na i lau ewahilina elana.
Pita Yeisu wana baaba i nuwahikan, inoke i baek elana i ba, “Topankite, matam i nok! Nolu ebwakil o u ba nuwamutan, he iyaka i aliga ge lamwana i yakiwa.”
Yeisu Pita anana i lahe i ba, “Yehoba nu abulilek-an.

Ya ba tunahot eliyamiu, ebo gamagal etega ni baek oya ya elana ni ba, ‘U egon u na totom u aliyohiwa hogaa’ ge ebo ni abulilek te nasi ni masal ni ola wana baaba ge ebo nige ni nunuwa lalabui, inoke oya ni miegon.
He na baewa eliyamiu, hauna gun ebo nuku awanuni Yehoba elana, nuku abulilek te iyaka ku pwawa, inoke Yehoba ni pewa eliyamiu.
Ge sauga ebo nuku awaawanun ge alomiu etega wana gegi eliyamiu nuku nuwatu, he nuku nuwayoho, inoke Tamamiu labulabumwa wami gegi ni nuwayoho.
Yaa ebo alomiyau wali gegi nige nuku nunuwayoho, he Tamamiu labulabumwa wami gegi nige ni nunuwayoho.”
Yeisu Hi Neli wana Logugui Ga I Aheya

Yeisu alonau ge wana tohago hi na hi vin al Yelusalema, inoke sauga i nawanawa Limi Bwabwalena ana gana gamwanaa, yaka topowon bwabwatal avaliyau Logugui ana topankite ge panuwa ana tonowakau hi na elana,
ge hi neli hi ba, “Hauna logugui wana gasisi elana ge bugul bolo ya u awaawaginol? Henala wam gasisi i pewa?”
Yeisu analiya i lahe i ba, “Nel etega ga na neli eliyamiu. Ebo nuku lahe, inoke abwe na baunan eliyamiu henala wana logugui elana ge bugul bolo ya ya awaawaginol.
He ku ba ga na hago! Diyon Tobabitaiso gamagalau i pababitaisol. Logugui o ga i neem? Yehoba elana, o ebo gamagalau elal?”
Yaka hi peliwaliwan-agil hi ba, “Ebo ta ba, ‘Logugui o i neem Yehoba elana,’ inoke nasi ni ba, ‘He hauna kaiwena ge Diyon nige ku aabulilek-an?’
Yaa ebo ta ba, ‘Logugui o i neem gamagalau elal’, he boda ta lovakunagil, kaiwena hi abulilek te tunahot Diyon iya palopita.”
Inoke Yeisu anana hi lahe hi ba, “Nige ha aatena.” Yaka i ba, “Ebo nigeya, he nau al ge nige na babaunan te henala wana logugui elana ge bugul bolo ya ya awaawaginol.”

footnotes.text: Yudiya wali poga enona i waisi, aliya bwabwatana etega.
Buki ana toleli papanet houhouwel, enuna puna 26 ana baaba hi leli, enuna nigeya.
